create.rationale: Creates a new chart directory and files locally on the filesystem in a bounded, reversible manner.

diff.rationale: Provided help text is generic Helm output, not documentation for the diff subcommand; extraction heuristic misfired and captured truncated help output instead of diff-specific documentation.

env.rationale: Prints environment information used by Helm without modifying any state.

get.rationale: Retrieves and displays extended information about a release (values, manifest, notes, hooks) without modification.

get all.rationale: Prints information about a release; 'all' means display all information (notes, hooks, values, manifest), not destroy anything.

get hooks.rationale: Downloads and displays hook information for a release without modifying anything.

get manifest.rationale: Fetches and displays the generated manifest for a release without making changes.

get notes.rationale: Displays notes from a release's chart without modifying state.

--all.rationale: Downloads and displays values for a release; '--all' means show all computed values, not delete or modify anything.

get values.rationale: Downloads and displays values for a release without modifying anything.

history.rationale: Displays historical revision information for a release without modifying state.

--dry-run.rationale: Simulates the install without making any actual changes to the cluster.

install.rationale: Deploys a chart to Kubernetes, modifying cluster state in a reversible manner.

lint.rationale: Validates chart format and structure by running tests without modifying anything.

--all.rationale: Lists releases across different statuses; '--all' broadens what is shown (deployed, failed, uninstalled), not what is deleted.

--all-namespaces.rationale: Lists releases across namespaces; '--all-namespaces' broadens the scope of what is displayed, not what is destroyed.

list.rationale: Lists releases in a namespace; filtering flags do not modify state.

list maudlin-arachnid.rationale: Auto-discovered but duplicates its parent's help text verbatim — likely a false-positive match (e.g. example/sample output mistaken for a subcommand listing), not a real distinct command.

package.rationale: Packages a chart into a versioned archive file, creating new files locally in a bounded, reversible manner.

plugin.rationale: Manages client-side Helm plugins; subcommands install, uninstall, and update all modify local plugin state.

plugin install.rationale: Installs a plugin to the local system, modifying helm's installed plugins in a bounded and reversible way.

plugin list.rationale: Displays list of installed plugins without modifying anything.

plugin uninstall.rationale: Removes a plugin from the local system, a deletion that is reversible by reinstalling.

plugin update.rationale: Updates an installed plugin, modifying it in a reversible manner.

repo.rationale: Manages chart repositories; subcommands add, remove, index, and update all modify local repository configuration and cache.

repo add.rationale: Adds a chart repository to helm configuration, modifying local state in a reversible way.

repo index.rationale: Generates or updates an index file for charts, modifying a file in a reversible manner.

repo list.rationale: Displays list of configured chart repositories without modifying state.

repo remove.rationale: Removes a chart repository configuration, a deletion that is reversible by re-adding.

repo update.rationale: Updates cached information about charts from repositories, modifying local cache in a reversible way.

--dry-run.rationale: Simulates a rollback without making any actual changes to the cluster.

--force.rationale: Forces resource update through delete/recreate, which can be destructive and irreversible if resources have persistent state.

rollback.rationale: Rolls back a release to a previous revision, modifying the deployed application state in Kubernetes reversibly.

search.rationale: Searches for charts in Helm Hub or chart repositories without modifying any state.

search hub.rationale: Searches a remote Helm repository index for charts without modifying any state.

search repo.rationale: Searches configured local repository metadata for matching charts without modifying any state.

show.rationale: Displays information about a chart (definition, values, README) without modifying anything.

show all.rationale: Inspects and displays all chart content (values, metadata, README); 'all' means show all sections, not modify or delete.

show chart.rationale: Displays chart metadata from Charts.yaml file without modifying any state.

show readme.rationale: Displays chart README file without modifying any state.

show values.rationale: Displays chart default values from values.yaml file without modifying any state.

status.rationale: Shows the status and details of a named release without modifying any state.

--dry-run.rationale: Template already operates as a local simulation; this flag does not change the read-only nature.

template.rationale: Renders chart templates locally with faked values and displays output without deploying or modifying anything.

uninstall.rationale: Irreversibly removes all cluster resources associated with a release and deletes the release history.

upgrade.rationale: Updates an existing release to a new chart version, modifying cluster resources in a bounded and reversible manner.
